# --- widget 253 (data-source) ---
global customer_profiles = source_table("customer_profiles", ["id", "customer_id", "phone", "loyalty_tier", "preferred_channel"])
print("customer_profiles: ", table_info(customer_profiles))

# --- widget 252 (data-source) ---
global customers = source_table("customers", ["id", "name", "email", "segment", "region", "created_at"])
print("customers: ", table_info(customers))

# --- widget 258 (data-source) ---
global events = source_table("events", ["row_id", "event_type", "entity_id", "payload", "ts", "channel"])
print("events: ", table_info(events))

# --- widget 256 (data-source) ---
global order_items = source_table("order_items", ["id", "order_id", "product_id", "qty", "line_total"])
print("order_items: ", table_info(order_items))

# --- widget 255 (data-source) ---
global orders = source_table("orders", ["id", "customer_id", "product_id", "qty", "amount", "status", "region_id", "channel", "created_at"])
print("orders: ", table_info(orders))

# --- widget 257 (data-source) ---
global payments = source_table("payments", ["id", "order_id", "method", "amount", "paid_at", "status"])
print("payments: ", table_info(payments))

# --- widget 254 (data-source) ---
global products = source_table("products", ["id", "name", "category", "price", "cost"])
print("products: ", table_info(products))

# --- widget 250 (data-source) ---
global regions = source_table("regions", ["id", "name", "manager"])
print("regions: ", table_info(regions))

# --- widget 251 (data-source) ---
global warehouses = source_table("warehouses", ["id", "region_id", "name", "capacity"])
print("warehouses: ", table_info(warehouses))

# --- widget 259 (processing-block) ---
# Filter: Active orders
# Input table: orders
orders = orders[("status" == "active")]
print("orders: ", table_info(orders))

# --- widget 264 (processing-block) ---
# Transform: Clean customers
# Input table: customers
customers = customers.map("name", trim)
customers = customers.map("name", upper)
customers = customers.rename("email", "email_address")
print("customers: ", table_info(customers))

# --- widget 267 (relationship) ---
# Relationship: Orders → Payments
# 1:N — relate(PK, FK…) first arg is primary key, rest are foreign keys on it
primary_key(orders["id"])
relate(orders["id"], payments["order_id"])
global orders_payments = left_join(payments, orders, "order_id", "id")
print("orders_payments: ", table_info(orders_payments))

# --- widget 270 (relationship) ---
# Relationship: Regions → Warehouses
# 1:N — relate(PK, FK…) first arg is primary key, rest are foreign keys on it
primary_key(regions["id"])
relate(regions["id"], warehouses["region_id"])
global warehouses_regions = left_join(warehouses, regions, "region_id", "id")
print("warehouses_regions: ", table_info(warehouses_regions))

# --- widget 268 (relationship) ---
# Relationship: Customers → Profiles
# 1:1 — relate(PK, FK) first arg is primary key, rest are foreign keys on it
primary_key(customers["id"])
relate(customers["id"], customer_profiles["customer_id"])
global customer_profiles_joined = left_join(customer_profiles, customers, "customer_id", "id")
print("customer_profiles_joined: ", table_info(customer_profiles_joined))

# --- widget 260 (processing-block) ---
# Transform: Normalize orders
# Input table: orders
orders = orders.map("amount", float)
orders = orders.rename("status", "order_status")
print("orders: ", table_info(orders))

# --- widget 261 (formula) ---
# Formula: Order VAT
# Input table: orders
# expressions: amount_vat = amount * 1.2 (outputMode=add)
orders!["amount_vat"] = orders["amount"].map(fn(v) => v * 1.2)
print("orders: ", table_info(orders))

# --- widget 265 (relationship) ---
# Relationship: Customers → Orders
# 1:N — relate(PK, FK…) first arg is primary key, rest are foreign keys on it
primary_key(customers["id"])
relate(customers["id"], orders["customer_id"])
global orders_customers = left_join(orders, customers, "customer_id", "id")
print("orders_customers: ", table_info(orders_customers))

# --- widget 262 (processing-block) ---
# Aggregate: Orders by customer
# Input table: orders
global orders_by_customer = orders.aggregate_group({
  group: "customer_id",
  total_amount: { op: "sum", column: "amount" },
  order_count: "count"
})
print("orders_by_customer: ", table_info(orders_by_customer))

# --- widget 263 (processing-block) ---
# Aggregate: Orders by region
# Input table: orders
global orders_by_region = orders.aggregate_group({
  group: "region_id",
  region_amount: { op: "sum", column: "amount" },
  region_orders: "count"
})
print("orders_by_region: ", table_info(orders_by_region))

# --- widget 269 (relationship) ---
# Relationship: Orders ↔ Products
# N:M — two 1:N relates through a junction table
primary_key(orders["id"])
primary_key(products["id"])
relate(orders["id"], order_items["order_id"])
relate(products["id"], order_items["product_id"])

# --- widget 266 (relationship) ---
# Relationship: Products → Orders
# 1:N — relate(PK, FK…) first arg is primary key, rest are foreign keys on it
primary_key(products["id"])
relate(products["id"], orders["product_id"])
global orders_products = left_join(orders, products, "product_id", "id")
print("orders_products: ", table_info(orders_products))
